confidence_notes: Food anchors rest on CityCost aggregate estimates (undated, not verified against current menus) and one undated Trip.com review of a Dadonghai pub; cocktail and wine anchors are weakly supported. Beer and cocktail are judgment calls informed by a sparse source; wine is set from the beer relationship (about 2.2x draft beer) with no direct price data. The midrange anchor is adjusted above the CityCost aggregate (about $22-25) for tourist-area pricing. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Sanya resort-market context, not from live listings; July is peak domestic season, so rates may be on the high side. FX observation is the most recent RBA table I could retrieve (18-20 March 2026), which is about seven months older than the generation date; third-party August 2026 data suggests a similar level (roughly 0.70 USD per AUD), but the RBA value was not confirmed as current.
comparable_city_reasoning: No close single comparable city was used. Food anchors draw on CityCost's Sanya aggregate with an upward adjustment for resort-area pricing; accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a mid-sized Hainan beach resort city in peak season.
